config.friendcreeper.title: Friend Creeper Settings
config.friendcreeper.allowOwnerDamage.to: Whether the owner can damage their own friend Creeper.
config.friendcreeper.followOwner.tooltip: Whether friend Creepers follow their owner.
config.friendcreeper.revengeOwner.toolti: Whether friend Creepers avenge their owner when attacked.
config.friendcreeper.snowGolemAttack.too: Whether Snow Golems can target friend Creepers.
config.friendcreeper.hurtSound.tooltip: Whether friend Creepers play a hurt sound when at low health.
config.friendcreeper.renderPoppy.tooltip: Whether to render the poppy on friend Creepers' heads.
config.friendcreeper.tamedCreeperTexture:
Whether friend Creepers use custom faces (happy face when healthy, sad face when low health).
If your custom resource pack is not working, try disabling this option.
config.friendcreeper.scaredFace.tooltip:
Whether friend Creepers show a scared face when fleeing from cats.
Requires Friend Creeper Face to be enabled.
config.friendcreeper.afraidOfCats.toolti: Whether friend Creepers are afraid of cats and ocelots.
config.friendcreeper.naturalRegeneration: Whether friend Creepers naturally regenerate health over time.
config.friendcreeper.feedOwnerCat.toolti:
Whether friend Creepers pick up raw fish and feed the owner's hurt cats.
Requires Afraid of Cats to be disabled.
config.friendcreeper.witherRoseOnLowHeal:
Whether friend Creepers show a wither rose instead of a poppy when at low health.
Requires Render Poppy to be enabled.
screen.friendcreeper.noconfig.line1: Cloth Config API is not installed
screen.friendcreeper.noconfig.line2: Friend Creeper requires Cloth Config API for graphical configuration
screen.friendcreeper.noconfig.line3: You can download it from Modrinth or CurseForge.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.friendcre: Tame Creepers with gunpowder and make them your friend.
